title: Endpoint Criteria for One-Dimensional Bilinear Rough Singular Integrals
summary: We prove endpoint theorems for one-dimensional bilinear rough singular integrals. Our starting point is a sharp structural characterization of the associated angular multiplier. For every mean-zero $Ω\in L^1(\mathbb{S}^1)$, the finite-part angular multiplier associated with $T_Ω$ has bounded variation if and only if the antipodal even part of $Ω$ belongs to $H^1(\mathbb{S}^1)$. This characterization identifies the precise rotational regularity required in the one-dimensional bilinear setting.
